chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Bakr ibn Salih, from Sulayman ibn Ja'far al-Ja'fari, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
"Whoever has intercourse with his wife during the new moon (end of month) should expect the loss of the child (miscarriage or stillbirth)."

key_terms.مُحَاقِ الشَّهْرِ: The period of new moon at the end of the lunar month when the moon is not visible

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marital intercourse during the new moon in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) links marital intimacy during the 'muhāq' (new moon phase) to the risk of miscarriage, reflecting the Shia tradition of combining spiritual discipline with empirical observation. It serves as a practical juristic guideline for couples, emphasizing that timing in conjugal relations carries both physical and metaphysical consequences within the framework of *'ilm al-awqāt* (knowledge of auspicious and inauspicious times).
